title: Industry 5.0 Smart Organizations: Adopting Agentic AI for Business Optimization in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
content: As technology continues to advance and enterprises increasingly deploy innovative digital technologies to power and transform  their business processes, Smart Organizations are adopting Agentic Artificial Intelligence (Agentic AI) to automate, optimize, and  enhance operational performance in the digital age. Unlike conventional AI systems that primarily execute predefined tasks and  provide analytical insights, Agentic AI possesses autonomous decision-making, adaptive learning, goal-oriented reasoning, and  proactive execution capabilities that enable organizations to respond dynamically to changing business environments. Within the  context of Industry 5.0, which emphasizes human-centricity, sustainability, resilience, and intelligent collaboration between  humans and machines, Agentic AI is emerging as a strategic enabler of business optimization and organizational transformation.  This study explores the adoption of Agentic AI within industry 5.0 Smart Organizations and examines its impact on operational  efficiency, decision-making quality, workforce productivity, customer experience, supply chain performance, and organizational  resilience. Drawing upon Human–AI Collaboration Theory, Socio-Technical Systems Theory, Dynamic Capabilities Theory, and  Industry 5.0 principles, the research proposes a conceptual framework that integrates autonomous AI agents, human expertise, and  digital enterprise ecosystems to create adaptive and self-optimizing organizations. The study further investigates the critical  success factors influencing Agentic AI adoption, including technological readiness, organizational culture, governance structures,  workforce competencies, data infrastructure, and ethical considerations.   The findings demonstrate that Agentic AI significantly contributes to business optimization by reducing operational inefficiencies,  improving resource utilization, accelerating decision cycles, enhancing predictive capabilities, and enabling continuous process  improvement. Furthermore, the research argues that the convergence of Industry 5.0 and Agentic AI represents a paradigm shift  from traditional automation toward autonomous, collaborative, and intelligent enterprise ecosystems where humans and AI agents  work synergistically to generate sustainable business value. The study contributes to the emerging body of knowledge on Industry  5.0 by providing theoretical and practical insights into how Smart Organizations can strategically leverage Agentic AI to achieve  competitive advantage, organizational agility, and long-term business sustainability in the age of artificial intelligence.
